title: Recombinant human KAI1/CD82 attenuates M1 macrophage polarization on LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells via blocking TLR4/JNK/NF-kappaB signal pathway.
authors: Lee, Hyesook; Han, Jung-Hwa; An, Kangbin; Kang, Yun Jeong; Hwangbo, Hyun; Heo, Ji Hye; Choi, Byung Hyun; Kim, Jae-Joon; Kim, Seo Rin; Lee, Soo Yong; Hur, Jin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究重组KAI1蛋白通过分子对接预测与TLR4结合抑制巨噬细胞炎症，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白对接而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: KAI1/CD82, a membrane tetraspanin protein, can prevent various cancers and retinal disorders through its anti-angiogenic and anti-metastatic capacity. However, little is known about its anti-inflammatory effect and molecular mechanism. Therefore, the present study aimed to inLPSvestigate effect of a recombinant protein of the large extracellular domain of human KAI1 (Gly 111-Leu 228, rhKAI1) on lipopolysaccharides (LPS)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophage-like cells and mouse bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDM) and to identify its underlying mechanism. Our data showed that rhKAI1 suppressed expression levels of classically macrophages (M1) phenotyperelated surface markers F4/80+CD86+ in LPS-stimulated BMDM and RAW264.7 cells. In addition, LPS markedly increased mRNA expression and release levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines and mediators such as interleukin (IL)-1beta, IL-6, tumor necrosis factor-alpha, cyclooxygenase-2, nitric oxide and prostaglandin E2, whereas these increases were substantially down-regulated by rhKAI1. Furthermore, LPS strongly increased expression of NF-kappaB p65 in the nuclei and phosphorylation of ERK, JNK, and p38 MAPK. However, nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65 and phosphorylation of JNK were greatly reversed in the presence of rhKAI1. Especially, rhKAI1 markedly suppressed expression of toll-like receptor (TLR4) and prevented binding of LPS with TLR4 through molecular docking predict analysis. Importantly, Glu 214 of rhKAI1 residue strongly interacted with Lys 360 of TLR4 residue, with a binding distance of 2.9 A. Taken together, these findings suggest that rhKAI1 has an anti-inflammatory effect on LPS-polarized macrophages by interacting with TLR4 and down-regulating the JNK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. [BMB Reports 2023; 56(6): 359-364].
abstract_zh: KAI1/CD82，一种膜四跨膜蛋白，可通过其抗血管生成和抗转移能力预防多种癌症和视网膜疾病。然而，关于其抗炎作用及分子机制知之甚少。因此，本研究旨在探讨人KAI1大胞外域重组蛋白（Gly 111-Leu 228，rhKAI1）对脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞样细胞和小鼠骨髓来源巨噬细胞（BMDM）的影响，并确定其潜在机制。我们的数据显示，rhKAI1抑制了LPS刺激的BMDM和RAW264.7细胞中经典巨噬细胞（M1）表型相关表面标志物F4/80+CD86+的表达水平。此外，LPS显著增加了促炎细胞因子和介质如白细胞介素（IL）-1β、IL-6、肿瘤坏死因子-α、环氧合酶-2、一氧化氮和前列腺素E2的mRNA表达和释放水平，而这些增加在rhKAI1存在下被显著下调。进一步地，LPS强烈增加了细胞核中NF-κB p65的表达以及ERK、JNK和p38 MAPK的磷酸化。然而，在rhKAI1存在下，NF-κB p65的核转位和JNK的磷酸化被大幅逆转。特别地，rhKAI1显著抑制了toll样受体（TLR4）的表达，并通过分子对接预测分析阻止了LPS与TLR4的结合。重要的是，rhKAI1残基的Glu 214与TLR4残基的Lys 360强烈相互作用，结合距离为2.9 Å。综上所述，这些发现表明rhKAI1通过相互作用于TLR4并下调JNK/NF-κB信号通路，对LPS极化的巨噬细胞具有抗炎作用。[BMB Reports 2023; 56(6): 359-364]。
